title: Kissinger among the first CIC officers in Oberammergau
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kissinger among the first CIC officers in Oberammergau, about 1945 at Oberammergau, Bavaria, Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Henry Kissinger was one of the first officers to occupy the barracks there in 1945.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode asking whether the American statesman Henry Kissinger oversaw a programme to recover crashed UFOs, says Kissinger was one of the first officers to move into the barracks at Oberammergau, a town in Bavaria, Germany, in 1945. Michels places him there as an officer of the Counter Intelligence Corps, the US Army's wartime counterintelligence branch. He tells it as an early link in Kissinger's supposed path into secret work.
